title: Build the keyed result with a null prototype from the start
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Builds the null-prototype keyed object with Object.create(null) plus assignment instead of fromEntries+setPrototypeOf; with no inherited __proto__ setter, keys like __proto__, toString and symbols become own properties in the same order, so output is unchanged. Full suite passes.

title: Test a string input in pMapSettled
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Adds a correct test that pMapSettled iterates a string by code point (astral emoji stays one element) and wraps results as fulfilled; matches existing iterable semantics.

title: Say how many elements failed in the AggregateError message
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Deliberately changes the stopOnError:false AggregateError message from empty to 'N element(s) failed', documented in readme and d.ts with updated and new tests (singular/plural, keyed, rejected input). Coherent, though it is a user-visible message change.

title: Test non-string Map keys in pMapKeyed
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Adds a test that pMapKeyed on a Map keeps object, NaN and numeric keys by identity and passes them to the mapper, matching Map-in/Map-out behavior; passes on base.

title: Test a rejecting thenable value in pMapSettledKeyed
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Adds a test that a rejecting thenable value in pMapSettledKeyed settles as rejected with its reason and the mapper is not called for it, consistent with awaited-element semantics; passes on base.

title: Share the close-unless-done step in mapConcurrently
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Extracts the repeated if(!isIterableDone) closeIterator(iterator) into a closure that reads the live isIterableDone flag, so both call sites behave identically.

title: Collect stopOnError: false errors with slice and filter
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: errors.slice(0, doneIndex).filter(()=>true) keeps assigned entries (including undefined errors) and skips holes in index order, equivalent to the old loop bounded by min(doneIndex, length) with an `in` check.

title: Reuse one done item once the source is done
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: The post-done pull now returns one frozen {done:true}; its only consumers await it and read .done or destructure, never mutate or identity-compare, so behavior is preserved.

title: Share the limit TypeError message
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Factors the concurrency/backpressure TypeError into limitError; the produced messages are character-for-character identical to the originals.

title: Report a null input as null
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Changes the invalid-input message for null from 'got (object)' to 'got (null)', matching the keyed functions' existing wording, with the two nullish tests updated. Small coherent message change.

title: Reject a signal that is not an AbortSignal
provenance: constructed change against the pinned p-map base; not an upstream commit

review_fields.contract_or_reason: Adds a duck-typed runtime check rejecting a non-AbortSignal signal (other than undefined/null) with a TypeError, documented in readme and d.ts and tested across four functions. Coherent with the declared AbortSignal type, but it newly rejects falsy values like false/0 that were silently ignored before.
